description: An event published when a shaping rule fires on a frame
title: io.synadia.ntf.event.v1.shaping_fired

id.description: Unique id of this event, a nuid

timestamp.description: The publisher's clock when the event was made, in RFC 3339 with nanoseconds

instance_id.description: The instance the event is about

source.description: The component that published the event

source_seq.description: Counts the source's events for the instance from 1 with no gaps

set.description: The id of the shaping set holding the rule

rule.description: The id of the rule that fired

rule_action.description: What the rule did to the frame: drop, stall, throttle or disconnect

wait.description: How long a stall or throttle held the frame in nanoseconds, zero otherwise

connection_uuid.description: The connection's uuid, the capture header's cuuid and the connection_uuid in TRACES metadata

frame_id.description: The id of the frame the rule acted on in the capture

server_name.description: The name of the server whose capture proxy the rule fired on, as capture_stored gives it
